page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. This CPU features 8 physical cores and 16 vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Cache specifications include 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 35 MB of L3 cache. The instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, and it is provisioned with a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the performance of this instance consistently in the average category. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance score is 1439.19, while the multi-core score reaches 15350.78. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block speed of 855.0 GB/sec and a large block write speed of 46.68 GB/sec. In application-specific benchmarks, the server achieves a static web serving throughput of 12.4 GB/sec and handles 15.39 million operations per second in Redis SET tests. For language model workloads, prompt processing with a small 135M model registers at 942.59 tokens per second, though performance drops to a weak rating of 23.22 tokens per second for prompt processing with a medium 7B model.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offer a stable resource profile for workloads requiring predictable compute performance without the overhead of local storage. The absence of bundled local storage means users must rely on network-attached storage, which represents a tradeoff in I/O latency. This server is suited for general-purpose workloads, static web serving, database operations, and lightweight software compilation tasks that benefit from dedicated Intel Xeon processing power.
